title: LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less
comment: Final version with new experiments and analyses, as accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research, August 2024 (Featured Certification). this https URL
abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely-used parameter-efficient finetuning method for large language models. LoRA saves memory by training only low rank perturbations to selected weight matrices. In this work, we compare the performance of LoRA and full finetuning on two target domains, programming and mathematics. We consider both the instruction finetuning (approximately 100K prompt-response pairs) and continued pretraining (20B unstructured tokens) data regimes. Our results show that, in the standard low-rank settings, LoRA substantially underperforms full finetuning. Nevertheless, LoRA better maintains the base model's performance on tasks outside the target domain. We show that LoRA mitigates forgetting more than common regularization techniques such as weight decay and dropout; it also helps maintain more diverse generations. Finally, we show that full finetuning learns perturbations with a rank that is 10-100X greater than typical LoRA configurations, possibly explaining some of the reported gaps. We conclude by proposing best practices for finetuning with LoRA.
title_ko: LoRA와 전체 파인튜닝의 학습량·망각 비교 분석
tldr: LoRA는 코드·수학 도메인에서 전체 파인튜닝보다 덜 배우지만 기존 능력도 덜 잊으며, 전체 파인튜닝의 가중치 변화는 LoRA 랭크보다 10~100배 높은 랭크를 가진다.
bullets: 문제: LoRA가 전체 파인튜닝만큼 배우는지, 망각은 덜한지 불분명함
방법: Llama-2-7B를 코드·수학의 CPT와 IFT로 LoRA·전체 비교
결과: LoRA는 덜 배우지만 덜 잊고 생성 다양성도 더 유지함
결과: 드롭아웃·weight decay보다 망각 완화 효과가 큼
한계: 7B 모델 하나와 코드·수학 두 도메인만 다룸
why: LoRA의 학습-망각 트레이드오프와 랭크·학습률·대상 모듈 선택 가이드는 부작용 최소화 파인튜닝을 설계할 때 바로 참고할 수 있다.

title: Does Fine-Tuning LLMs on New Knowledge Encourage Hallucinations?
comment: Accepted as a long paper at EMNLP 2024
abstract: When large language models are aligned via supervised fine-tuning, they may encounter new factual information that was not acquired through pre-training. It is often conjectured that this can teach the model the behavior of hallucinating factually incorrect responses, as the model is trained to generate facts that are not grounded in its pre-existing knowledge. In this work, we study the impact of such exposure to new knowledge on the capability of the fine-tuned model to utilize its pre-existing knowledge. To this end, we design a controlled setup, focused on closed-book QA, where we vary the proportion of the fine-tuning examples that introduce new knowledge. We demonstrate that large language models struggle to acquire new factual knowledge through fine-tuning, as fine-tuning examples that introduce new knowledge are learned significantly slower than those consistent with the model's knowledge. However, we also find that as the examples with new knowledge are eventually learned, they linearly increase the model's tendency to hallucinate. Taken together, our results highlight the risk in introducing new factual knowledge through fine-tuning, and support the view that large language models mostly acquire factual knowledge through pre-training, whereas fine-tuning teaches them to use it more efficiently.
title_ko: 새 지식으로 파인튜닝하면 환각이 늘어나는지 검증
tldr: 파인튜닝 데이터에 모델이 모르는 새 사실이 섞이면 느리게 학습되지만, 결국 학습되면 환각이 선형적으로 늘어나므로 조기 종료나 해당 예제 필터링이 유효하다.
bullets: 문제: SFT 중 새 사실을 배우면 환각이 늘어난다는 통설이 검증되지 않았다.
방법: 모델 지식 기준으로 예제를 4단계(SliCK)로 분류하고 Unknown 비율을 조절했다.
결과: Unknown 예제는 느리게 학습되고, 학습될수록 환각이 선형으로 증가했다.
결과: 조기 종료나 Unknown 필터링으로 과적합 위험을 줄이고 성능은 유지됐다.
한계: 단일 LLM, 단답형 폐쇄형 QA만 다뤄 장문 생성 일반화는 미검증이다.
why: SFT 데이터 큐레이션에서 모델이 모르는 사실이 담긴 예제를 걸러내거나 MaybeKnown 예제를 섞는 근거를 제시해 데이터 선택 관점에서 유용하다.
